reason: shadcn's input-otp.tsx wraps the React-only input-otp 1.5.0 library (OTPInput + OTPInputContext). The Phlex port adds no JavaScript dependency (no npm package, importmap pin or vendor file; same constraint as command/cmdk, item #178): OTPInput's DOM and state machine (container, input wrapper and transparent input with the library's inline styles and data-input-otp-* attributes, the slot context with char/isActive/hasFakeCaret, selectionchange normalization, focus selection, pattern filtering, maxLength truncation, the 0/10/50 ms sync timers, the password-manager badge push, the iOS/pasteTransformer paste path, the injected #input-otp-style sheet and onComplete) are re-implemented in the chadcn--input-otp Stimulus controller on the shared template_mount primitive, so the compared DOM equals the oracle in the scenarios. The remaining differences are forced by a server render or by Ruby: (1) the fake caret exists in React only while a slot is active and empty, which the server cannot know, so its markup ships in an inert <template> (no data-slot, not in the document) as each slot's last child and is mounted by template_mount; (2) React's client render leaves <noscript> empty (React DOM sets noscript children as text content), while the port renders the SSR form <noscript><style>fallback</style></noscript> so the no-JS fallback works; neither is a data-slot element; (3) the render prop and pasteTransformer are JS functions with no Ruby value: render is not offered (the block is the children) and pasteTransformer is assigned on the controller from JavaScript; (4) callbacks are events: onChange is chadcn--input-otp:change and onComplete is chadcn--input-otp:complete, detail { value }; (5) Stimulus wiring (data-controller on the container, targets on the input, slots and caret templates, the slot index in a data-*-value attribute) is added and ignored by the runner.
api: input-otp library re-implemented in the chadcn--input-otp Stimulus controller (shared primitive template_mount); no npm dependency, importmap pin or vendor file
InputOtp::Slot ships the fake caret in an inert <template data-chadcn--input-otp-target="caret"> (no data-slot) as its last child, mounted by template_mount while the slot is active and empty
InputOtp renders <noscript><style>NO_SCRIPT_CSS_FALLBACK</style></noscript> (SSR form); React's client render leaves the noscript empty
OTPInput render prop is not offered (the block is the children); pasteTransformer (JS function) is assigned on the chadcn--input-otp controller from JavaScript
OTPInput onChange is the event chadcn--input-otp:change and onComplete is chadcn--input-otp:complete (detail: { value })
Stimulus wiring attributes (data-controller on the container, targets on input/slots/caret templates, slot index as a data-*-value attribute) are added; the runner ignores them
